name: interview-insights
description: Convenience scripts across api/web/workers/services. Each service keeps its own package-lock.json and is built/deployed independently (see each Dockerfile) — this is not an npm workspaces root.

scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix api && npm run lint --prefix web && npm run lint --prefix services/notification-service && npm run lint --prefix services/review-analyzer
scripts.test: npm test --prefix api && npm test --prefix web && npm test --prefix services/notification-service && npm test --prefix services/review-analyzer
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix api && npm run build --prefix web && npm run build --prefix workers && npm run build --prefix services/notification-service && npm run build --prefix services/review-analyzer
